failure: The generated new-file patch declared and contained only 85 lines; its final catch_unwind closure and test-body delimiters were absent, so rustfmt reported an unclosed delimiter at line 85.
cause: The manually frozen patch hunk length truncated six intended closing lines during patch construction.
repair: Before any build or test, extend the patch hunk to 91 lines, restore the six intended closing lines in both the patch artifact and detached checkout, then rerun the formatting-only check.

formatting_followup.finding: The syntax repair succeeded; rustfmt then identified six style-only line-wrapping differences. The patch and checkout were normalized identically before freeze.

scientific_interpretation: None. This was an unfrozen test-patch packaging failure and consumed no scientific process reservation.
